title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NDAGIRIYEMUNGU
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. NDAGIRIYEMUNGU
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00613/2021/CA (Ndahayo, J. P.) 30 Mutarama
2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Icyaha cyo gukubita no gumeretsa byateye urupfu –
Icyaha cy’ubwicanyi – Ibishingirwaho mu gutandukanya icyaha cyo gukubita no gumeretsa
byateye urupfu n’icyaha cy’ubwicanyi – Kumenya niba uwakubise undi ku bushake yari afite
umugambi wo kumwica cyangwa niba yari agamije gusa kumukubita cyangwa kumukomeretsa,
bisuzumirwa mu cyakoreshejwe (intwaro ishobora kwica) mu kumukubita no ku gice cy’umubiri
cyakubiswe (mu cyico).
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo
kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu
nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Ndagiriyemungu yacyetsweho kuba yarakubise ibuye mu mutwe uwitwa
Niyitegeka bimuviramo urupfu, aregwa mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Nyarugenge icyaha cyo
gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu, maze Urukiko rwemeza ko ahamwa n’icyo cyaha,
rumuhanisha igihano k’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000, runamutegeka kwishyura
indishyi z’akababaro zingana na 4.030.000Frw.
Uregwa yajuririye Urukiko Rukuru avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha kandi yari yagaragaje ko habayeho
ubusembure buturutse ku kuba Nyakwigendera yari agiye gusambanya mwishywa we agahita
amutera ibuye, akaba atari yagambiriye kumwica. Yasabye kandi ko yasubukirwa ibihano kugira
ngo abone uko ajya kwivuza kuko arwaye. Urukiko Rukuru rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko
ubujurire bwe nta shingiro bufite, ko igihano yahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye kigumyeho.
Uregwa yongeye kujurira bwa kabiri muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire avuga ko Urukiko Rukuru
rwanze guha agaciro impamvu yatanze y’ubusembure bwa nyakwigendera, ndetse rwanga
kumugabanyiriza ibihano kandi atararuhije ubutabera, kuko yaburanye yemera icyaha mu nkiko
zombi, akaba ari ubwa mbere yari akurikiranwe mu nkiko, bityo asaba guhabwa ibihano bito
bishoboka ndetse Urukiko rukajya no munsi y’igihano gito giteganywa n’itegeko kubera impamvu
nyoroshyacyaha, agahabwa igihano cy’igifugo kingana n’imyaka 5.
Ubushinjacyaha bwasubije ubujurire bw’Uregwa buvuga ko nta busembure bwabayeho kuko
nyakwigendera atigeze asagarira Uregwa. Busobanura ko bushingiye ku mvugo
z’abatangabuhamya, impamvu Uregwa atanga yo kuba nyakwigendera yari agiye gusambanya
mwishywa bitafatwa nk’ubusembure, kuko abari bahari bamutesheje bamusaba gutaha iwe, naho
Uregwa aba ariho amusanga amutera ibuye mu mutwe biza kumuviramo urupfu. Ubushinjacyaha
buvuga ko icyo yita ubusembure atari igikorwa cyabaye ako kanya ngo ahite agisubirizaho.
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga kandi ko inyito y’icyaha Uregwa yahamijwe yo gukubita no gukomeretsa
byateye urupfu igomba guhinduka, ikaba ubwicanyi hashingiwe ku kuba yarafashe ibuye akaritera
nyakwigendera mu mutwe agapfa, ndetse akaba atagomba kugabanyirizwa ibihano kuko Urukiko
Rukuru rwamugabanyirije rumaze gusuzuma impamvu nyoroshyacyaha yagaragazaga.

Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Kumenya niba uwakubise undi ku bushake yari afite umugambi wo
kumwica cyangwa niba yari agamije gusa kumukubita cyangwa kumukomeretsa, bisuzumirwa mu
cyakoreshejwe (intwaro ishobora kwica) mu kumukubita no ku gice cy’umubiri cyakubiswe (mu
cyico).
2. Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku
mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya
munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko No 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko No 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange.
Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange nk’uko
ryahinduwe kugeza ubu, ingingo ya 107 n’iya 121.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA0110/10/CS, Ubushinjacyaha v. Uwamurengera rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa
31/01/2014.
RPAA00974/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Rwabuhungu Jeremie rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 28/05/2025.
RPAA 00371/2023/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Simbandumwe Etienne rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 23/05/2025.
RPAA00616/2021/CA, Ubushinjacyaha v. Nsanzuwera Aphrodis rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 30/11/2022.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Ku wa 16/12/2019 ari mu mudugudu wa Kibaya, Akagari ka Kamashashi, Umurenge wa
Nyarugunga, akarere ka Kicukiro, Umujyi wa Kigali, Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney
yacyetsweho kuba yarakubise ibuye mu mutwe uwitwa Niyitegeka François Xavier bimuviramo
urupfu.
[2] Iperereza rirangiye, ubugenzacyaha bwamuregeye ubushinjacyaha, Ubushinjacyaha
bumukurikiranyeho icyaha cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu mu rukiko Rwisumbuye
rwa Nyarugenge, mu rubanza RP00095/2020/TGI/NYGE rwemeza ko ahamwa n’icyaha,
rumuhanisha igihano k’igifungo kingana n’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000, runamutegeka guha
Musabyimana Josiane indishyi z’akababaro zingana na 4.030.000Frw.
[3] Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yajuririye Urukiko Rukuru, asobanura ko yahamijwe
icyaha kandi yari yagaragaje ko habayeho ubusembure bwa nyakwigendera kuko yasanze
nyakwigendera agiye gusambanya umwishywa we ahita amukubita ibuye ko ariko atari

yabigambiriye, asaba kugabanyirizwa ibihano ndetse bigasubikwa kugirango abone uko ajya
kwivuza kuko arwaye.
[4] Mu rubanza RPA01163/2019/HC/KIG rwaciwe ku wa 21/5/2021 rwemeza ko ubujurire
bwe budafite ishingiro, rwemeza ko igihano k’igifungo kingana n’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya
5.000.000Frw yahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye kigumyeho.
[5] Mu gufata icyemezo, Urukiko rwashingiye ku ukuba ibyo Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie
Vianney avuga ko yasembuwe na Niyitegeka kuko ngo yaragiye gusambanya umwishywa we nta
shingiro byahabwa kuko mu batangabuhamya babajijwe barimo Gasibante Muhamed,
wasobanuye ko uregwa yaje agasanga uwitwa Mugarura yaramaze gukura Niyitegeka kuri uwo
mwana w’umukobwa,ashatse kumukubita baramubuza babwira Niyitegeka gutaha agenda yiruka
Ndagiriyemungu amwirukaho, Niyitegeka ageze iwe aramwihisha ariko Ndagiriyemungu
aramukurikirana amukubita ibuye mu mutwe ageze imbere ahita yikubita hasi; ko izo mvugo
z’uwo mutangabuhamya zigaragaza ko Niyitegeka yari yagiye yamuhunze ahubwo
Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney akaba ari we wamukurikiranye, ko rero izo mvugo zigize
ikimenyetso kigaragaza ko niba Niyitegeka yari yagiye ikibazo cyarangiye, Ndagiriyemungu Jean
Marie Vianney akamukurikira iwe, ko byo atabyita gusemburwa.
[6] Urukiko rwasanze kandi Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yaragabanyirijwe ibihano
kuburyo buhagije kuko icyaha yakoze cyo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu
giteganyirizwa igihano cy’igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka (15) ariko kitarenze imyaka
makumyabiri (20) n’ihazabu y’amafaranga y’u Rwanda atari munsi ya miliyoni eshanu
(5.000.000Frw) ariko atarenze miliyoni zirindwi (7.000.000Frw) ariko we urukiko rukaba
rwaramugabanyirije ahanishwa igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15, ibyo rero bigaragaza ko
yagabanyirijwe ku buryo buhagije kandi byakurikije amategeko kuko icyo gihano aricyo gito
cyateganyirijwe icyo cyaha igihe habayeho kugabanya ibihano; ko rero rusanga ntayindi mpamvu
yatuma agabanyirizwa ibihano mu gihe bigaragara ko byagabanyijwe.
[7] Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yongeye kujuririra Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza
ruhabwa RPAA00613/2021/CA ruburanishwa ku wa 09/01/2026, Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie
Vianney yunganiwe na Me Munyensanga Amina Gisele, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na
Mbaragijimana Desire; kuri uwo munsi urubanza ntirwaburanishijwe kuko uregera indishyi atari
yitabye ndetse ntanikigaragaza ko yahamagajwe, aribwo urubanza rwashyizwe ku wa 23/01/205,
kuri uwo munsi Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yitaba Urukiko yunganiwe na Me
Munyensanga Amina Gisele, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Ntawangundi Beatrice.
[8] Kuri uwo munsi, Urukiko rwafashe icyemezo cyo kuburanisha uregera indishyi adahari
kuko atari yitabye urukiko nta mpamvu kandi yarahamagajwe mu buryo bukurije amategeko.
[9] Mu mwanzuro utanga ubujurire no mu miburanire ya Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney
n’umwunganizi we avuga ko urukiko rwanze guha agaciro impamvu yatanze y’ubusembure bwa
nyakwigendera ndetse rwanga kumugabanyiriza ibihano kandi atararuhije ubutabera kuko
yaburanye yemera icyaha mu nkiko zombi, akaba ari ubwa mbere yari akurikiranwe mu nkiko,
asaba guhabwa ibihano bito bishoboka ndetse Urukiko rukajya no munsi y’igihano gito
giteganywa n’itegeko kubera impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, agahabwa igihano cy’igifugo kingana
n’imyaka 5.

[10] Uhagarariye ubushinjacyaha avuga ko nta busembure bwabayeho kuko nyakwigendera
atigeze asagarira Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney. Akomeza avuga ibyo avuga ko ngo
nyakwigendera yari agiye gusambanya umwishywa we, bitafatwa nk’ubusembure kuko nk’uko
abatangabuhamya babisobanuye, nyakwigendera yari yagiye iwe, hanyuma Ndagiriyemungu
amukurikira iwe, aba ariho amuterera ibuye biza kumuviramo urupfu. Ko rero ibyo bigaragara
neza ko icyo yita ubusembure atari igikorwa cyabayeho ako kanya ngo ahite agisubirizaho.
[11] Uhagarariye ubushinjacyaha ahubwo avuga ko we abona ko inyito y’icyaha
Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yahamijwe yo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu
igomba guhinduka, asoza avuga ko abona uregwa atagomba kugabanyirizwa ibihano kuko
Urukiko rwamugabanyirije rumaze gusuzuma impamvu nyoroshyacyaha yagaragazaga.
[12] Hashingiwe ku bimaze gusobanurwa haruguru, Urukiko rurasanga ikibazo kigomba
gusuzumwa ari ukumenya niba hakurikijwe ibikorwa byakozwe na Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie
Vianney mu ikorwa ry’icyaha, inyito y’icyaha yahamijwe yahinduka, ndetse no kumenya niba hari
ubusembure bwatewe na nyakwigendera mu ikorwa ry’icyaha no kumenya niba yagabanyirizwa
ibihano.
II. ISESENGURA RY’IBIBAZO BIGIZE URUBANZA
1) Kumenya niba hakurikijwe ibikorwa byakozwe na Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie
Vianney mu ikorwa ry’icyaha, inyito y’icyaha yahamijwe yahinduka
[13] Uhagarariye ubushinjacyaha ahubwo avuga ko we abona ko inyito y’icyaha
Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yahamijwe yo gukubita no gukomeretsa byateye urupfu
igomba guhinduka ikaba ubwicanyi hashingiwe ku kuba yarafashe ibuye akaritera nyakwigendera
mu mutwe agapfa.
[14] Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney n’umwunganizi we bo bavuga ko babona ko inyito
y’icyaha itagomba guhinduka kuko n’ubwo bigaragara ko yakubise nyakwigendera ibuye ibuye
mu mutwe, ndetse muganga akaba yaremeje ko nyakwigendera yishwe n’ibibyimba yagize ku
bwonko byatewe no gukubitwa iryo buye ngo yapfuye hashize nk’amezi abiri ari kwa muganga,
ko rero bitaba ubwicanyi kuko kugirango byitwe ubwicanyi, hagomba kuba habayeho kugambirira
kwica no kuba hari umugambi wo kwica wateguwe n’uwakoze icyaha, akaba atari ko byagenze.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[15] Hakurikijwe imiburanire y’impande zombie, ikibazo kigomba gusuzumwa ni ukumenya
niba hakurikijwe ibikorwa byakozwe n’uregwa inyito y’icyaha yahamijwe yo gukubita no
gukomeretsa byateye urupfu yahinduka ikaba ubwicanyi.
[16] Mu gusesengura hashingirwa ku byemejwe ku kibazo kijyanye no kumenya ibishingirwaho
ngo hemezwe niba uwakubise undi ku bushake yari afite umugambi wo kumwica cyangwa niba
yari agamije gusa kumukubita cyangwa kumukomeretsa, byasesenguwe mu rubanza
RPAA0110/10/CS rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 31/01/2014 haburana ubushinjacyaha
na Uwamurengera, Urukiko rwemeje ko mu kumenya niba uwakubise undi ku bushake yari afite
umugambi wo kumwica cyangwa niba yari agamije gusa kumukubita cyangwa kumukomeretsa,

bisuzumirwa mu cyakoreshejwe (intwaro ishobora kwica) mu kumukubita no ku gice cy’umubiri
cyakubiswe (mu cyico). Uyu murongo wagiye ukurikizwa mu manza nyinshi zitandukanye
uheruka akaba ari urubanza RPAA00974/2024/CA rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa
28/05/2025 Ubushinjacyaha buburana na Rwabuhungu Jeremie (igika cya 12).
[17] Dosiye y’Urubanza igaragaza raporo ya muganga yakozwe ku wa 11/03/2020 igaragaza
ko Niyitegeka Francois Xavier yishwe n’ihungabana rikabije ry’ubwonko, kumeneka amaraso mu
miyoboro y’ubwonko ndetse no gutoboka kw’igihanga, akaba yaritabye Imana azize ingaruka
zihungabana rikabije ry’ubwonko.
[18] Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney n’umwunganizi we imbere y’urukiko biyemerera ko
yafashe ibuye arikubita Niyitegeka mu mutwe, ko kandi uko gukubitwa mu mutwe aribyo byateye
urupfu kuko byamuteye ikibazo k’ibibyimba ku bwonko bikamutera urupfu nk’uko byemejwe na
muganga wakoze isuzuma.
[19] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga hashingiwe ku gice cy’ubumubiri Ndagiriyemungu Jean
Marie yakubiseho nyakwigendera (mu mutwe) ndetse n’icyakoreshejwe mu gukubitwa (ibuye)
ibyo bikaba aribyo byateye ikibazo cyo kuvira ku bwonko ari nabyo byatumye nyakwigendera
apfa nk’uko bigaragazwa na raporo ya muganga, bigaragaza ko icyaha cyakozwe ari ubwicanyi
hashingiwe ku murongo watanzwe haruguru ujyanye n’ibishingirwaho mu gutandukanya icyaha
cyo gukubita no gumeretsa byateye urupfu n’icyaha cy’ubwicanyi.
2) Kumenya niba harabaye ubusembure bwa yakwigendera mu ikorwa ry’icyaha
[20] Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney n’umwunganizi we basobanura ko urukiko rwanze
guha ishingiro impamvu yatanze y’ubusembure kandi yaragombaga guhabwa ishingiro kuko
yavuye mu kabari agasanga mwishywa we arimo arira avuga ko nyakwigendera yari agiye
kumusambanya ndetse akaba yari yanamuciriyeho imyenda abantu baramumutesha.
[21] Uhagarariye ubushinjacyaha avuga abona nta busembure bwabayeho kuko uwari ugiye
gusambanywa atari Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney ahubwo ari mwishywa we, kandi nk’uko
abatangabuhamya babisobanuye, nyakwigendera yari yagiye iwe ahunze Ndagiriyemungu
amukurikira iwe aba ariho amuterera ibuye biza kumuviramo urupfu, ibyo rero akaba asanga
bigaragara ko icyo yita ubusembure atari igikorwa cyabayeho ako kanya ngo ahite agisubirizaho.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[22] Mu gusuzuma iki kibazo hashingirwa ku byemejwe mu rubanza RPAA00616/2021/CA
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 30/11/2022 haburana ubushinjacyaha na Nsanzuwera
Aphrodis, urwo rukiko rwemeje ko uwajuriye agomba kugaragaza amakosa ari mu rubanza
rujuririrwa, agasobanura impamvu ari amakosa, agatanga n’uburyo agomba gukosorwa, bivuze ko
uwajurije afite ishingano yo kugaragaza ukwibeshya kwakozwe n’Urukiko rubanza gushingiye ku
mategeko cyangwa ku byabaye kwatumye urubanza rujuririrwa rucibwa nabi cyangwa kwatuma
ruta agaciro, uyu murongo wagiye ukurikizwa mu manza nyinshi uheruka akaba ari urubanza
RPAA00371/2023/CA rwaciwe ku wa 23/05/2025 haburana ubushinjacyaha na Simbandumwe
Etienne.

[23] Nk’uko bigaragara muri dosiye kuva mu gace ka 11 kugeza mu ka 12, Urukiko Rukuru
rwasanze ibiburanishwa na Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney ko mu ikorwa ry’icyaha habaye
ubusembure bw’uwakorewe icyaha, nta shingiro byahabwa hashingiwe ku mvugo
z’abatangabuhamya babajijwe.
[24] Urukiko rwasobanuye ko umutangabuhamya witwa Gasibante Muhamed yavuze ko
Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yaje agasanga uwitwa Mugarura yari yamaze gukura
Niyitegeka kuri uwo mwana w’umukobwa noneho Ndagiriyemungu yashaka kumukubita
bakamubuza ahubwo basaba Niyitegeka gutaha, aribwo yatanze agenda yiruka Ndagiriyemungu
amwirukaho amukubita ibuye mu mutwe ageze imbere ahita yikubita hasi, ndetse n’imvugo z’uwo
mukobwa wari ugiye gusambanywa wasobanuye ko Niyitegeka yihishe Ndagiriyemungu
hanyuma Niyitegeka aza kuva mu bwihisho aza kwa Ndagiriyemungu kugirango biyunge
bakemure ikibazo ariko ngo Ndagiriyemungu akaba yarahise azana ikibuye akagikubita
Niyitegeka mu mutwe. Urukiko rero rwasanze izo mvugo zigaragaza ko nta busembure bwabayeho
kuko nyakwigendera yari yagiye ahubwo uregwa aramukurikirana.
[25] Nk’uko bimaze gusobanurwa haruru, Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga ibimenyetso bimaze
kurondorwa bigaragaza ko hakurikijwe uko ibintu byagenze ntacyo rwashingiraho rwemeza ko
hari ubusembure bwabayeho nk’uko Ndagiriyemungu abivuga kuko uretse kuvuga ko Urukiko
Rukuru rwanze guha ishingiro impamvu y’ubusembure yaburanishaga, ntacyo agaragaza anenga
ibimenyetso byashingiweho mu kwemeza ko nta busembure bwabayaho.
[26] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga nk’uko Urukiko Rukuru rwabisobanuye mu buryo
bukwiye, nta busembure bwabayeho kuko nyakwigendera koko yashatse gusambanya uwo
mwana, ariko abantu baramumutesha ndetse birarangira aribwo banabwiye nyakwigendera
kugenda agahunga uregwa, ndetse nyakwigendera arigendera ajya kwihisha ariko uregwa akomeza
kumukurikirana abonye asohotse aho yari yihishe amukubita ibuye ryamuviriyemo urupfu, ibi rero
bikaba bigaragaza ko nta busembure bwabayeho kuko ibintu byari byarangiye ahubwo uregwa
akaba yaragize ubushake bwo kumukurikirana kugeza amukubise ibuye.
3) Kumenya niba igihano Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yahanishijwe kingana
n’imyaka 15 cyagabanywa
[27] Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney n’umwunganizi we basaba ko yagabanyirizwa
ibihano kuko yemeye icyaha, akaba ari ubwa mbere akurikiranweho icyaha mu nkiko,
agahanishwa igihano k’igifungo kingana n’imyaka 5. Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko atagomba
kugabanyirizwa ibihano kuko busanga yaragabanyirijwe ku buryo buhagije.
[28] Hakurikijwe icyaha NDAGIRIYEMUNGU Jean Marie Vianney ahamijwe cy’ubwicanyi
kandi iki cyaha kikaba giteganyirizwa igifungo cya burundu nk’uko biteganywa mu ngingo ya 107
y’itegeko Nº68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange1, ndetse haba
hemejwe impamvu nyoroshyacyaha, icyo gihano kikagabanywa ntabwo gishobora kujya munsi
1 Iyo ngingo iteganya ko Umuntu wica undi abishaka, aba akoze icyaha. Iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko, ahanishwa
igifungo cya burundu.

y’imyaka 15 nk’uko biteganywa mu ngingo ya 2 (a) y’itegeko no 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023
rihindura itegeko No 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange2.
[29] Urukiko rurasanga rero igihano Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney yahanishijwe
kingana n’imyaka 15 kitagomba kugabanywa kuko icyo gihano ari cyo gito giteganyirizwa icyaha
yahamijwe ndetse kikaba kitanagomba kongerwa kuko uregwa ariwe wajuriye wenyine.
III. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[30] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwatanzwe na Ndagiriyemungu Jean Marie Vianney nta shingiro
bufite.
